title: Investor Psychology and Behavioral Finance Foundations
description: A beginner-friendly, India-specific guide to the mental traps that quietly cost retail investors money. Built for first-time demat holders, college students, salaried professionals, homemakers, and retirees, this course explains why smart, well-informed people still buy high, sell low, chase WhatsApp tips, and panic during a crash. Covers the core biases behind bad investing decisions, how they show up specifically in the Indian market (IPO frenzy, SIP discipline, Diwali bonus spending, the 2020 Covid crash), and practical, rules-based ways to protect yourself from your own brain.
